zh.DIST_TARGET_PAIR_REQUIRED: DIST_OS 和 DIST_ARCH 必须成对提供且不能为空。
zh.DIST_TARGET_INVALID_OS: 不支持的目标系统：{value}；只允许 linux、darwin、windows。
zh.DIST_TARGET_INVALID_ARCH: 不支持的目标架构：{value}；只允许 amd64、arm64。
zh.DIST_TARGET_INVALID_PLATFORM: 不支持的 PLATFORM：{value}；Go 构建只支持 host 或 linux。
zh.DIST_TARGET_INVALID_ARGUMENT: dist target 命令参数无效。
zh.DIST_TARGET_SOURCE_OVERWRITE: 产物目录或清单不能覆盖源码清单：{path}。
zh.DIST_TARGET_INVALID_MANIFEST: 产物清单不是有效的 YAML 对象：{path}。
zh.DIST_TARGET_YAML_DEPENDENCY: 缺少 yaml 依赖；请先安装前端依赖：{path}。
zh.DIST_TARGET_BINARY_METADATA: 无法读取 Go 二进制的 GOOS/GOARCH：{path}。
zh.DIST_TARGET_BINARY_REQUIRED: Go 产物必须提供至少一个待校验的二进制。
zh.DIST_TARGET_MANIFEST_MISMATCH: 产物清单的 target 与本次构建目标不一致：{path}。
zh.DIST_TARGET_BINARY_MISMATCH: 二进制目标不一致：{path}，实际 {actual}，要求 {expected}。
zh.DIST_TARGET_IO_ERROR: dist target 文件操作失败：{path}。
zh.DIST_TARGET_VERIFIED: 产物 target 与二进制校验通过：{target}。

en.DIST_TARGET_PAIR_REQUIRED: DIST_OS and DIST_ARCH must be provided together and must not be empty.
en.DIST_TARGET_INVALID_OS: Unsupported target OS: {value}; allowed values are linux, darwin, windows.
en.DIST_TARGET_INVALID_ARCH: Unsupported target architecture: {value}; allowed values are amd64, arm64.
en.DIST_TARGET_INVALID_PLATFORM: Unsupported PLATFORM: {value}; Go builds support host or linux.
en.DIST_TARGET_SOURCE_OVERWRITE: The artifact directory or manifest must not overwrite the source manifest: {path}.
en.DIST_TARGET_INVALID_MANIFEST: The artifact manifest is not a valid YAML object: {path}.
en.DIST_TARGET_YAML_DEPENDENCY: Missing yaml dependency; install frontend dependencies first: {path}.
en.DIST_TARGET_BINARY_METADATA: Cannot read GOOS/GOARCH from the Go binary: {path}.
en.DIST_TARGET_BINARY_REQUIRED: A Go artifact must provide at least one binary to verify.
en.DIST_TARGET_MANIFEST_MISMATCH: The artifact target does not match this build target: {path}.
en.DIST_TARGET_VERIFIED: Artifact target and binary checks passed: {target}.
